name: Winpak Ltd.
summary: Winpak Ltd. manufactures and distributes packaging materials and related packaging machines in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. It operates through three segments: Flexible Packaging, Rigid Packaging and Flexible Lidding, and Packaging Machinery.
